Subject: Re: Next steps for disconnected cluster rollout — provenance evidence and runbook

Thanks for the call earlier. As discussed, Acme is planning to accept our VPC-islanded deployment next month and wants a concise provenance checklist and a dry-run/operational rehearsal before the scheduled window.

Attached is a first pass: rdw_provenance_checklist_v1.pdf. High level asks:
- We need a signed manifest template the operator can present on-site.
- A short rehearsal script for the operator (simulated activation, image verification, and rollback).
- Explicit acceptance evidence items (signatures, checksums, courier receipts).

Can you confirm the list covers what your auditors require? Also flag any additional TTL/retention items for evidentiary logs. Monica and I will coordinate operator availability and the rehearsal timeline.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw_provenance_checklist_v1.pdf (PDF, 38KB)
From: Acme Sec Ops <ops@acme-security.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps for disconnected cluster rollout — provenance evidence and runbook

Rishi —

Thanks for the checklist. High level feedback from Acme audit team:
1) The signed manifest needs explicit fields for operator identity + HSM key thumbprint used to sign. Example included inlined below.
2) We will need courier chain-of-custody: manifest + tamper-evident seal photos, timestamped, and GPS waypoint of handoff if available.
3) Retention: logs of the verification steps (sha256 checks, kernel/boot hashes) must be kept for 3 years in read-only storage.

Do you have a sample signed-manifest.json we can validate against our parser? Also — we prefer the rehearsal to include a cold-start scenario where the device is powered off and the operator boots from media and performs the verification steps. That exposes any missing operators steps.

If possible, please include the operator-run script as a bare text file so our SREs can lint it against our acceptance tooling.

Regards,
Priya Varma
Lead SecOps (Acme Financial Services)

Timeline: Acme wants the rehearsal within 2 weeks. Monica — can you confirm operator roster and 2 candidate days for the run? We'll also capture photo evidence steps in the checklist.

Thanks — please keep replies threaded and include any blockers.

— Rishi

Rishi / Monica —

Thanks for the ask. Team deliverables attached: signed-manifest-example.json (small), operator-rehearsal-script.md, and a sample export of audit lines (we'll hand over read-only tar). Key notes:

1) Manifest: includes operator id (LDAP uid), HSM key fingerprint, bootstrap image SHA256, and an RFC3339 timestamp. We sign the manifest using our KMS-backed HSM signing flow and provide a detached signature.

2) Rehearsal script highlights:
   - Pre-accept checklist (operator ID + ID scan, tamper seal photolog, seal serial match)
   - Cold boot steps: insert media, power on, confirm bootloader hash, run rdw-verify --manifest <file>
   - Acceptance step: operator signs acceptance token using local smartcard, uploads signed token to a sealed USB for courier (we log the signature hex)
   - Rollback: reapply previous bundle from read-only media and confirm service enters degraded mode with expected logs

3) Audit export: we will provide a gzipped read-only bundle containing timestamped verification lines. Retention policy can be set to 3 years per Acme requirement; we will propose an S3 Glacier Archive + CICD snapshot workflow as an option.

Next actions:
- Monica: confirm two rehearsal dates (we propose 2026-10-07 or 2026-10-12) and confirm on-site operator(s).
- Rishi: I'll upload the three artifacts to the shared Drive and to the HubSpot record. Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/dirs/Shared/airgap-proofs/ACME-2026-09 and HS-4321.

Attachments: signed-manifest-example.json (JSON, 2KB); operator-rehearsal-script.md (MD, 6KB); audit-sample.log.gz (GZ, 24KB)

Jonas Weber
Director, Inference Ops
Redwood Inference
